data.name: Muktipriya
data.gender_notes: Muktipriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muktipriya is a name of a goddess, often revered in Hindu tradition. She is the embodiment of liberation from suffering and bondage, and a symbol of spiritual freedom. Her name signifies the one who is dear to those who seek liberation. The name Muktipriya carries the meaning “Liberated One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muktipriya usually hope their child will grow to embody liberated one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Muktipriya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberated One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muktipriya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muktipriya evokes deep religious feelings and holds a significant place in Hindu culture. It is commonly used as a title or honorific for goddesses associated with liberation or freedom, particularly in Maharashtra, India. People who seek her blessings believe that she grants them the strength, courage, and wisdom to overcome hardships and ultimately achieve spiritual freedom.
data.spiritual_significance: Muktipriya represents the ultimate goal of spiritual growth and self-realization. Her name conveys the idea of being cherished by those who seek freedom from the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. The name resonates with the deeper truths of Hindu philosophy and serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual journey towards enlightenment. Her name embodies the inner longing and ultimate aim of all sincere spiritual seekers: to be free from suffering, bondage, and ignorance, and to attain moksha or salvation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Muktipriya: One deeply devoted to attaining liberation (Mukta) from the cycle of rebirth (Samsara) and seeking the grace of the Almighty (Priya) in the journey towards enlightenment.

vedic_reference.note: Muktipriya is a name for a female who is loved or favored by Goddess Mukti.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muktipriya was a Jain Tirthankara of the 22nd cycle of 24 Tirthankaras. The name Muktipriya carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Muktipriya continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
